question: What characterizes those who know all the Vedas in this teaching's address?
premises: Knowers of all Vedas are addressed.
They are associated with good conduct and good vows.
inference: True knowledge of all Vedas is linked with good conduct and disciplined vows.
uncertainties: The sentence continues into the next verse.
plain_english: O brāhmaṇa of good vows, the knowers of all the Vedas live by good conduct.
